snippet.title: Vampirium: 1997 - Announce Teaser
snippet.description:
1997. Dracula is King of England. At his command, master your dark gifts to assassinate his enemies and secure his vampiric empire. Infiltrate locked-down locations, adapt and survive in living environments and uncover your own unique methods of executing missions.

🩸 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4035190/Vampirium_1997
